title: American pilots trained to fly UFOs despite time displacement

tellings.quote: they conveyed to him that they were training pilots to fly UFOs.

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani, speaking to podcast host Jesse Michels, relays a story he credits to a man named Lyn Buchanan. According to Jorjani, Buchanan was told that American pilots were being trained to fly UFOs at a deep underground site in California, even though flying them caused a strange shift in the pilots' sense of time. If true, it would mean the US has working alien craft and people to fly them.
